source: Fixed product copy written by the project: one plain-English label per canonical assertion ID in evaluation/assertion_definitions.json (policy-v1.3). Never generated at runtime and never taken from model output. Each label says what a FAIL of that assertion means.

labels.fit.coverage_complete: predictions are not exactly one per fold, or are not traceable to their producing step
labels.fit.state_dependencies_within_fold_train: a preprocessing or model step was fit on rows outside its fold's training data
labels.metric.prediction_ids_match_eval_ids: the predictions do not cover exactly the rows each fold was meant to evaluate
labels.metric.reported_matches_recomputed: the reported metric does not match the metric ATLAS recomputed
labels.split.evaluation_folds_nonempty: a declared evaluation fold contains no evaluation rows
labels.split.no_group_overlap: the same subjects appear in training and testing
labels.split.no_row_overlap: the same rows appear in both training and testing
labels.split.no_shared_source_observation: the same source observation appears in both training and testing
labels.split.no_window_overlap: a training time window overlaps an evaluation window in the same stream
labels.split.repeated_measures_rule: repeated measurements of one subject are split across training and testing
labels.split.sampling_unit_disjoint: the same sampling units (subjects) appear on both sides of a split
labels.split.temporal_separation: training and evaluation items are closer in time than the declared minimum gap
labels.temporal.cutoff_precedes_evaluation: the training cutoff, plus the allowed gap, is not before the earliest evaluation time
labels.temporal.features_available_when_used: a feature value was used before the time it became available
labels.temporal.training_labels_available_by_cu: a training row or its label is dated after the training cutoff
